title: Nondeformability of Moishezon manifolds with nonnegative Kodaira dimension
summary: Let $π:\X\to\D$ be a proper holomorphic submersion with connected fibers, and suppose that $X_t$ is biholomorphic to a fixed smooth Moishezon manifold $S$ for every $t\ne0$. If $κ(S)\ge0$, we prove that $X_0\simeq S$.
